home.description: Welcome to my website! I'm a lifelong learner and builder of software. Here you'll find my projects, curriculum, experiences, and much more. Feel free to explore and get in touch with me :)
home.featured_desc: A selection of my recent work and experiments.

projects.page_description: Projects, works and ideas that I have developed throughout my journey as a developer.

project_rescue.title: Facial Recognition System with AI for medical applications - Mondragon, Spain.
project_rescue.description: This system was developed in a team at Mondragon University. The idea is to use a Convolutional Neural Network model for facial recognition and retrieval of medical information about patients.

project_geniuslab.title: Library Management System 'Genius Lab'.
project_geniuslab.description: This project earned me my first internship. Developed in Django with a PostgreSQL database, the project is a library management system with features for borrowing, returning, registering books and users, and generating reports.

project_bingo.title: Bingo! Have fun with your friends.
project_bingo.description: I did this project more for the technical challenge. It was built using only JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, without frameworks. The idea came up because we have bingo cards at home, but we didn't have anything to draw and play with friends. It's a very simple but functional project.

project_lc.title: LC Vistoria Veicular Webpage
project_lc.description: LC Vistoria Veicular is a vehicle inspection company accredited by DETRAN-PE. I developed the page using NextJs and TypeScript, aiming to create a modern and functional online presence for the company. The main idea is to provide useful information for customers.

work_in_progress.title: Oops! Page under construction.
work_in_progress.description: This page is still under construction. Our best cat engineers are working on it!

cv.summary: Fullstack Developer with experience in Python/Django, TypeScript/NextJs, Java Spring Boot and VueJs. I have a strong interest in learning by doing and sharing knowledge, specially subjects like software architecture, scalability, AI assisted development and business related topics. Seeking a position to apply fullstack skills, build scalable APIs, and contribute to impactful software solutions.

experience.description: I work on training models of Artificial Intelligence agents, such as personal assistants and software agents.
Semester abroad studying Software Engineering, AI, Project Management, and Data Analysis. Developed a CNN-based facial recognition project for medical applications.
VueJs developer building features and refactoring. Stack: TypeScript, VueJs, GitLab, Vitest.
Python/Django developer maintaining a management system. Stack: Python, JavaScript, Docker, Celery, Selenium.
Developer at a university junior enterprise simulating real work environments.
Taught algorithms and programming to elementary school children (CODE project).
Participated in a hands-on Django project from sketch to production.
